Full list of 2026 American holidaysCopy linkBookmark popoverRemoved from bookmarksClose popoverGood Friday and Easter are not federal holidays in the United States (Getty Images)Many Americans are gearing up for Easter weekend but they should note that Good Friday and Easter are not federal holidays in the U.S.The U.S. will recognize eleven federal holidays in 2026, one less than 2025, which featured Inauguration Day. The next federal holiday in the U.S. is Memorial Day on Monday, May 25.Friday, June 19, is Juneteenth National Independence Day, and Independence Day will be recognized on Friday, July 3 this year. Other federal holidays include Labor Day, on Monday, Sept. 7, Columbus Day on Monday, Oct. 12, and Veterans Day on Wednesday, Nov. 11.
